ticket.body:
Difficulty: medium

## Why
A stuck client-side dialog stays on screen after the character recovers.

## What
Implement automatic dismissal of a dialog that persists across two checks, using the existing detector.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A dialog that persists across two checks is dismissed automatically.
- [ ] A transient dialog, or ordinary text in the same screen band, is never clicked.
- [ ] The click is computed from the measured position, so it survives a change of resolution.
- [ ] Nothing in the path can raise into the poll loop that holds a client.

## Size
S

## Out of scope
- Anything else.
ticket.title: Dismiss a stuck dialog when it persists
